services.name: Wedding Party Cruise
services.desc: You said yes to planning the bachelorette party. Then somebody in the group chat said “Nashville,” somebody else said “party boat,” and now 14 people are waiting on you to make it happen. Deep breath. This is the exact checklist we give brides and maids of honor who book with us every weekend - what to lock in first, what to bring, what to skip, and the day-of timeline that keeps the whole crew on the boat instead of stuck in a parking lot group-texting “where r u.” Short on time? Saturdays on Percy Priest Lake book out weeks ahead in season. If your date is set, check bachelorette boat availability now - then come back and finish the checklist. services.name: Family Boat Rental Features
services.desc: Make your wedding celebration truly unforgettable by hosting a pre-wedding bash or post-wedding party on one of our luxurious party boats. Whether you’re planning a lively bachelorette party before the big day or a relaxed gathering after the wedding, our party boats offer the perfect blend of elegance, fun, and breathtaking views to celebrate your special occasion. Enjoy the stunning waterways of Nashville, capture beautiful photos, and create lasting memories. Our fleet features modern, well-maintained boats equipped with all the amenities you need for a memorable wedding

services.name: Pontoon rental
services.desc: We launch from Vivrett Creek Public Boat Ramp (5598 Alvin Sperry Rd, Mt. Juliet) on Percy Priest Lake, about 20 minutes from downtown Nashville. From there your captain takes you to the best spots on the water - including the famous Party Cove, where the floating party stretches boat-to-boat all summer. Prefer to keep

includes: Water toys like lily pads and pool noodles
blurb: Rowdy Boats offers captained party pontoon rentals on Percy Priest Lake with a capacity of up to 22 guests per boat. Rentals include a licensed captain, coolers, ice, water toys like lily pads and pool noodles, and a premium sound system. The standard cruise duration is 3 hours, with customizable packages for events like birthdays, bachelorette parties, and corporate outings.
